title: Gibraltar Point Lighthouse

buildingCutout.basis: Replace only the named lighthouse stone footprint.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation just east of the mapped stone footing.

mapIdentity.provider: Named OpenStreetMap standing outline, corroborated by the City of Toronto park guide.
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap way 892934946 gives the outline of the named six-sided tower at 480 Lakeshore Avenue, matching Wikidata Q5559191 and the City’s standing lighthouse.

note: The Toronto Public Library and 2015 conservation authority report document the hexagonal Queenston-stone structure, a heightening in 1832, and a historic overall height of 82 feet to the vane. The present gallery, iron lantern and finial proportions follow the author-released 2011 view.
